mood: Landscape digital character collage on dusty pink. An asymmetric chestnut crown and softly lit cheek overlook a fitted black bodice and gathered pale apron. A bare arm bends down, hand at waist; a separate white-ruffled shoulder threads its triangular opening. These two masses dominate. Small petalled wrist pleats, layered apron folds, a short sleeve chain and a pencil-grained hem tuck remain attached to the costume.
material_language: Smooth digitally shaded skin and glossy chestnut hair with narrow reflective streaks
Black satin and cool-white pleated ruffles; fine cracking confined to one black shoulder surface
Soft gathered apron fabric with restrained colored fold interiors and local pencil-like grain
Cool metallic links resting against a puff sleeve
lighting: Soft frontal light models the cheek and bare arm; narrow hair and metal highlights, cool fold shadows, uninterrupted matte dusty pink.
object_inventory: A bare bent arm rests its hand at a fitted waist above a gathered pale apron.
A broad black puff shoulder has fine cracks and an irregular white ruffle.
Small white wrist pleats open over muted coral edges and pale yellow lining.
Overlapping pale apron folds expose narrow muted green and blue undersides.
A short articulated silver chain lies along a black puff-sleeve seam.
A pale curled hem tuck carries faint violet pencil grain and a soft outline.
negative_constraints: No raised-arm pose, detached apron, hidden waist contact or shoulder that fills and erases the arm opening.
No separate animal, wheel, globe, flower bouquet or colorful accessory assemblage.
No detection boxes, tracking rays, confidence labels, cursors, target rings, pins, colored markers or captions.
No pasted images, framed paintings, cards, tickets, barcodes, typography, logos or interface chrome.
No repeated standing lineup, exact facial likeness or near-identical source recreation.
No stretching, forced cropping, padding, unrelated setting or all-over texture that erases costume structure.
